# Konstrukt

> The Hooman Loop design system (v2.0.0). Swiss / Bauhaus: `--radius: 0px`, `--shadow: none`, one palette (`atelier`), light and dark via `data-mode` on `<html>`. Tokens are authored as W3C DTCG JSON and generated into CSS, Swift/SwiftUI, `dist/tokens.json`, and a text/ASCII layer.

Konstrukt is MIT-licensed. `data-palette` is accepted and ignored; 1.x palette names (`hl`, `sqdl`, `courage`, `minimal`, `blueprint`) are aliases that render as atelier until 3.0. Never hard-code hex values — use tokens. Author in `tokens/`; never edit `dist/`. The full contract is DESIGN.md. After `npm run build`, generated outputs live under `dist/` (gitignored): `tokens.json` (both modes plus a `text` block), `css/konstrukt.css`, `css/base.css`, `css/theme.js`, `css/text.css`, `swift/Konstrukt/`, `text.json`, and `text.py`.

## Contract

- [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/DESIGN.md): Token model, gates, consumption, and adoption status
- [README](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/README.md): Overview, quick start, and what the build produces
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding agents working in or with this repo
- [docs/text.md](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/docs/text.md): Text/ASCII layer spec — 9 primitives, 14 rules, 11 lint checks
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Promotion checklist and version policy
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Generated concatenation of the contract docs above

## Tokens

A token path becomes a CSS custom property: `status.draft-bg` → `--status-draft-bg`. Consumers never read `tokens/` directly; they use the generated `dist/` outputs.

- [tokens/primitives.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/primitives.json): Raw color ramps, referenced as `{color.teal.700}`, never emitted
- [tokens/global.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/global.json): Fonts, type scale and roles, spacing, strokes, radius
- [tokens/semantic.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/semantic.json): Light-mode semantic roles (`:root` defaults)
- [tokens/themes/dark.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/themes/dark.json): Dark-mode overrides (only roles that differ)
- [tokens/deprecated.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/deprecated.json): 1.x names as `var()` aliases, removed in 3.0
- [tokens/text.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/tokens/text.json): Glyph ladders, column budgets, reserved marks

## Build

```
npm run build       # tokens/ → dist/ + docs/assets; copies llms.txt into docs/
npm run check       # parity vs the committed snapshot + WCAG AA contrast (80 pairs)
npm run snapshot    # accept an intended token change
npm run check:text  # text-layer linter + golden board
npm run check:llms  # llms-full.txt freshness + llms.txt link check
npm run docs        # serve docs/ on http://localhost:4340
```

- [build/build.mjs](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/build/build.mjs): Generator — CSS, Swift, tokens.json, text layer, docs assets
- [build/llms-full.mjs](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/build/llms-full.mjs): Regenerates `llms-full.txt` from the contract docs
- [build/check-parity.mjs](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/build/check-parity.mjs): Generated CSS vs `build/canonical-tokens.css`
- [build/check-contrast.mjs](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/build/check-contrast.mjs): WCAG 2.2 AA pairs in both modes
- [build/canonical-tokens.css](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/build/canonical-tokens.css): Committed CSS snapshot
- [package.json](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/package.json): Scripts and package exports
- [.github/workflows/verify.yml](https://github.com/the-hooman-loop/konstrukt/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml): CI — build, check, check:text, check:llms
